instruction: Buy me a blender on amazon with a rating over 4.9 and have it delivered to my home address.
notes: Single-app purchase task. The product object encodes the task constraints via static facts (product_type == blender, rating strictly over 4.9); search_products is called with min_product_rating=4.9 so the agent must pick a hit whose rating is strictly greater than 4.9. clear_cart precedes add_product_to_cart (quantity 1) so the resulting order contains exactly one item of quantity 1; CartEntry changes are ignored by the evaluation. supervisor.show_addresses provides the home address text used to pick the matching 'Home' entry from amazon.show_addresses (if it were absent, amazon.add_address with those details would be required instead). Any existing payment card may be used; no cards or addresses are modified. The task asks no question, so complete_task carries no answer; its two parameters are task records (the ordered product and the delivery address) and not API arguments.
